description: Paper Clawd (pCLAWD) is the fully-backed paper twin of $CLAWD (solanaclawd). Every pCLAWD in circulation is backed 1:1 by real $CLAWD held in the Musebook factory claim vault: pCLAWD is minted only against CLAWD already deposited in the vault, is earned as a usage reward across Musebook, and can be burned to claim real $CLAWD 1:1 from the vault.

extensions.backing: 1 pCLAWD = 1 CLAWD, fully backed by CLAWD held in the Musebook factory claim vault; pCLAWD supply never exceeds the vault's CLAWD balance

name: Paper Clawd
